title: DurableTaskState
description: Task lifecycle state contract. The lifecycle state is a closed enum distinct from the backend-observed RunState dimension; one side MUST NOT overwrite the other. succeeded/failed/cancelled are terminal and MUST NOT roll back; reconciliation_required MUST NOT be silently rewritten into success or failure - it converges only through an explicit reconciliation action. Field ownership (platform projection vs host authority) is declared by consumers; this contract fixes only the state vocabulary. Unknown fields MUST be tolerated.
